statements.proposition: This change alters no existing behaviour and breaks nothing: it consists only of documentation (docstring) additions.
statements.label: FALSE
statements.note: The library code is behaviour-identical (docstring-stripped AST of every changed pythonbpf/*.py file is equal at base and head), so 'maintain existing functionality, no breaking changes' holds for the package. But 'only documentation additions' is literally false: .gitignore gains a vmlinux.py line and tests/passing_tests/ringbuf.py gains a 'while True: print("running")' loop (a behaviour change to that test script). Labelled FALSE on the plain meaning of 'only'; a reader weighing the package-only sense might say TRUE.
